RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-women panel isn't evidence of anything on its own. In secondary education, women are a large majority of teachers and school leaders, so a four-woman panel is close to what random selection would produce. Raising it would make you look like you're searching for a grievance, and it would overshadow your genuinely strong point.

Your real argument is the record: a master's in educational leadership and five years as deputy principal against "courses" and classroom experience. Panels do legitimately weight teaching experience heavily, but that gap deserves explanation.

Focus on the unanswered request. Two weeks' silence is the concrete failure. Send a written follow-up citing your right to reasons, and set a deadline.
